name: ERA5 hourly data on pressure levels
description: Copernicus Climate Data Store ERA5 reanalysis dataset on pressure levels.
user_goal: Draft a small pressure-level ERA5 contract matching this intended workflow: temperature at 500 hPa, temperature at 850 hPa, and geopotential at 500 hPa; start_date is 2024-01-01; end_date is 2024-01-31; timestep is every 3 hours. Keep remaining choices minimal and human-editable.
